description: Forty-year hydropower generation reanalysis for Conterminous United States is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sean W. D. Turner et al. First published in 2022, the RectifHyd dataset provides hydrologically consistent estimates of monthly net generation for approximately 1,500 hydropower plants in the United States, addressing a gap in industrial surveys that have collected monthly generation data from only ~10% of plants post-2003. Coverage: national (US); published in 2025. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States) and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
